column1: # Book 6 review (Fable, 2026-10-30). No findings. Secondary 6.90 accepted (caeli divisis partibus is an ablative absolute: the augurs' division of the sky, not the addressee's). Secondary 6.30-31 rejected: naturali is ablative and agrees with both casu and vi, so "natural chance or force" keeps it, with Bailey; the two lines are only rebalanced. Refrains: 6.35 and 6.38 = 2.55 and 2.58 verbatim; 6.60-61 and 6.94-95 = 1.153-154 verbatim (capital at the sentence start); 6.62-70 = 5.82-90 verbatim (the Book 5 review text; 6.70 keeps the Latin's semicolon); 6.91-93 made identical with 6.383-385, same Latin. Band: 6.7, 6.9, 6.22, 6.27, 6.42, 6.45, 6.54, 6.73, 6.75, 6.96, 6.101, 6.104. 6.16 plural (the subject of cogi is the men of 6.12).
